## About
Showcase Auto Body Inc is a full-scale auto body shop on Old Camplain Rd in Hillsborough, New Jersey. We handle collision repair, vehicle painting and body work, from simple repainting to major wreckage.
An accident is frustrating enough. We work with all insurance companies and complete the paperwork, so you can focus on getting back on the road. Bring your car in whether it was damaged in a collision, a storm or hail.
Stop by or give Stan a call to talk through the damage on your vehicle.

## Services
- Collision repair: After-collision service from start to finish, so you can get your car back on the road.
- Vehicle painting and color matching: Repaint jobs for scratches, fading and storm or hail damage, with color matching so the repair blends in.
- Vehicle body work: A wide range of auto body work done at our shop to give your car a fresh look.
- Pinstriping: Pinstriping to customize the look of your car to your style.
- Fleet accounts: Sign up for a fleet account and we will repair collision damage and handle repaints for your vehicles to keep downtime short.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies and complete the necessary paperwork.

Q: Can you tow my car to the shop?
A: Yes. Towing service is available, and we can tow your car in and get it repaired.

Q: Do you repair storm and hail damage?
A: Yes. Whether your car was damaged in a collision, a storm or hail, bring it in.

Driving home, we passed Showcase, turned around, went in, and spoke with Stan. “No problem, my guys will bend it back into shape. About $250.” Won’t break the window? Nope, they do it all the time and have seen much worse. We dropped the car off that evening and it was fixed by lunchtime the next day. A couple of weeks later, we hit a deer, wrecking the hood, grille, headlight, fender, and side view mirror. Back to Showcase. Stan ordered all the parts, pre-painted everything, and when everything was ready and true to his word , he had the car fixed in two days at the price he quoted us. He also, without charge, took some dents out of a door that had been previously hit by a deer, and touched up the little scratches and dings on the rest of the car.
